app_fee.value: The international degree-seeking application fee is $75.

fee_waiver.value: The Graduate School gives no fee-waiver codes; a department may offer a code to a few applicants through a competitive process.
fee_waiver.quote: Departments may be able to offer a fee waiver code to a limited number of applicants based on a competitive process.

gre_general.value: Only a few programs require the GRE; each program record gives its own rule.
gre_general.quote: A few academic programs require GRE/GMAT scores (see table below)

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT 4.5 minimum for tests taken on or after January 21, 2026 (79 for earlier tests).
toefl_min.quote: IBT TOEFL (internet based) [Valid scores earned on or after January 21, 2026] ... 4.5

english_waiver.value: India is not on the Graduate School's list of countries exempt from the English test, and no medium-of-instruction exception is stated, so Indian applicants need a test score.
english_waiver.quote: English proficiency test scores are required if English is not your native language and you are not a US Citizen or Permanent Resident

also.quote: Applicants from the following countries are not required to provide English proficiency test scores

notes: Doctoral programs taken from K-State's official program contacts list (gradapply.ksu.edu embed). The Graduate School's Feb. 1 international fall deadline is used where a program states none. Handbook says the test date must be within 18 months; the application page says two years, so check.
